entry.name: The live store still ingests and verifies
entry.expected: Follow PLAN-3.md Notes (AC6): build with `cargo build --release -p terminus`, take a VACUUM INTO copy (or the newest snapshot) of the live store into a mktemp dir under $HOME, and point TERMINUS_DATA_DIR at it. `./target/release/terminus ingest` exits 0 and names no failed file; `status --json | jq .data.last_run.error` prints null; `verify` prints no failure line and exits 0
entry.why_human: Out-of-reach resource: it needs John's live store, a personal archive of about 3 GiB outside the repository, and the dispatch says not to run it as a machine check. The nearest machine probe (truth 10, a temp store written by the installed 1.0.0 binary) passed, but it does not carry the live store's real history, such as evicted sessions and absolute keys
